gap_days_threshold.description: Standard maximum calendar day gap between consecutive trading dates for an individual stock. Gaps exceeding 30 calendar days trigger a hard segment break unless qualifying as a market-wide closure.

bridge_max_gap_days.description: Maximum calendar day duration for a market-wide trading suspension to be bridged as a continuous trading regime. Accommodates systemic halts (such as the 52-day nationwide CSE lockdown from 2020-03-20 to 2020-05-11 during COVID-19) where prices resume orderly trading immediately upon exchange reopening.

shared_gap_fraction.description: Minimum proportion of active universe constituents (80%) that must synchronously share an identical calendar gap for it to be classified as an exchange-wide closure rather than a company-specific suspension or illiquidity halt.

hard_break_gap_days.description: Upper bound beyond which no gap may be bridged under any condition. All voids exceeding 60 days (including the 278-day 2021 void and 642-day 2022-2024 void) are unconditionally treated as hard breaks across macroeconomic regimes.

split_ratio_tolerance.description: Allowed relative deviation (5%) between observed price ratio (Close_{t-1} / Close_t or inverse) and canonical stock split ratios (2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 5.0, 10.0 and their inverses). Accommodates normal single-day market drift on the effective ex-date while isolating mechanical corporate actions.

extreme_move_20pct.description: Daily absolute close-to-close return threshold of 20% used for general excess-volatility auditing and market outlier monitoring.

extreme_move_50pct.description: Daily absolute close-to-close return threshold of 50% used for identifying suspect moves, unadjusted corporate actions, capital restructuring, and data anomalies.

min_universe_constituents.description: Minimum cross-sectional active voting series count required on date t to construct the equal-weighted market index and calculate cross-sectional median excess returns and percentile ranks.

top_k.description: Top-K portfolio size representing the top quintile (25%) of the 20-stock S&P SL20 universe for concentrated portfolio evaluation.

embargo_trading_days.description: Post-training embargo buffer (1 calendar week / 5 trading days) separating the purged training window from the test block start to prevent auto-correlated boundary leakage.

transaction_cost_per_side_bps.description: ASSUMPTION: Realistic Colombo Stock Exchange trading friction of 1.0% (100 bps) per side (200 bps round-trip). Accounts for brokerage commission (~0.64%), CSE/SEC statutory levies (~0.28%), Share Transaction Levy (STL), and execution market impact in frontier equity markets.

bootstrap_draws.description: Number of resamples for moving-block bootstrap (block length equal to horizon h) to construct empirical 95% confidence intervals for cross-sectional Rank IC without relying on invalid asymptotic t-distribution assumptions under overlapping return windows.

random_baseline_draws.description: Monte Carlo repetitions for the zero-intelligence random benchmark to obtain a smooth, unbiased null expectation.

short.description: Short-term tactical horizon representing approximately one calendar month of trading.

mid.description: Medium-term quarterly horizon representing approximately three calendar months (one financial quarter) of trading.

long.description: Long-term strategic horizon representing approximately one calendar year (252 trading days) of trading.

tier_cutoff_short.method: Evaluated candidate fractions [0.10, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30] of rankable stocks. No candidate achieved positive lift over median in >= 2/3 dev years (all achieved 6/12 = 50.0%). Standard quartile convention 25% applied.

tier_cutoff_mid.method: Evaluated candidate fractions [0.10, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30]. Selected largest qualifying fraction (30%) with positive lift in 9 of 12 dev years (75.0%, pooled lift +1.66%).

tier_cutoff_long.method: Evaluated candidate fractions [0.10, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30]. Selected largest qualifying fraction (30%) with positive lift in 8 of 10 dev years (80.0%, pooled lift +5.98%).

risk_category_low_cutoff.method: 33.3rd percentile of trailing annualized 63-day volatility (vol_63d) pooled across dev rankable rows.
risk_category_low_cutoff.data_used: Dev period clean rankable rows (2002-2019, 59,102 rows)

risk_category_high_cutoff.method: 66.7th percentile of trailing annualized 63-day volatility (vol_63d) pooled across dev rankable rows.
risk_category_high_cutoff.data_used: Dev period clean rankable rows (2002-2019, 59,102 rows)

liquidity_warning_cutoff.method: 20th percentile of trade_day_share_63m (share of last 63 market calendar days with traded observations within segment) pooled across dev rankable rows. Warning fires when stock is at or below this cutoff.

overall_weight_short.method: Normalized weight proportional to evidence points (Short RED = 1 pt out of 4 total points).

overall_weight_mid.method: Normalized weight proportional to evidence points (Mid AMBER = 2 pts out of 4 total points).

overall_weight_long.method: Normalized weight proportional to evidence points (Long RED = 1 pt out of 4 total points).

thin_trading_flag.description: Series whose median calendar days spanned by 21 consecutive trading rows exceeds 1.5x the market median. All 'N trading day' windows count the stock's own trading observations, which span longer calendar time for thinly traded stocks.
